targets.outcome_quote:
As shown in Fig. 2, there is no statistically significant difference observed between the workload in the Non-AR condition and AR conditions
among women (t(15)=−1.91,p=0.07) (in contrast to the original study

targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly contrast the women’s Non-AR/AR comparison with the original significant result, while reporting agreement for men and for the two AR modes. Statements validating trends and engagement address particular findings; they do not erase the explicit contrast.

reasoning: New conference participants retest Adams et al. (2023) with real astronomy stimuli. Original data are used for between-study comparisons, but the central test uses new participants. Mini-VLAT is a new extension, not a retest of its validation paper. Title, authors, full manuscript and reference boundaries verified.
